summary: Iteration 82 targeted regression after startup index-consolidation robustness fix (_norm_dir + caller default index changed to {user_id,create_dt,id}). Ran 22 pytest tests against the live backend covering /api/version marker, admin default list + scope=all count resolution, sorts, filters, phone search, caller default list on new 3-field index (fast + desc-sorted), caller scope=all global search, group_counts (lead_stage/user_id), same-day merge (create/merge/new phone), and Ozonetel CDR (create + repeat ucid dedupe). ALL 22 PASSED in 6.80s.

test_results.TestAdminLeads (6): PASS — default list fast, scope=all total resolved to a real number (~120k), sorts (create_date, -create_date, lead_stage) OK, lead_stage filter OK, date_from/date_to filter OK, phone search OK
test_results.TestCallerLeads (4): PASS — caller11 default list returns quickly (<20s), items are desc-sorted by create_dt (verifying the new {user_id,create_dt,id} index covers the sort with no residual blocking sort), scope=all lets them search globally, alt sorts OK
test_results.TestGroupCounts (2): PASS — lead_stage & user_id both return within 15s with non-empty response
test_results.TestSameDayMerge (4): PASS — webhook created, 1st post creates (merged_same_day=false), 2nd same-phone returns merged_same_day=true / merged_into=leadA, different phone creates new lead. Cleaned up.
test_results.TestOzonetelCDR (2): PASS — new NotAnswered CDR returns 200 in <6s and auto-creates lead; repeat with same ucid updates same call_event (no duplicate). Cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: _norm_dir() correctly wraps int conversion in try/except and falls back to a stable string tuple key for non-b-tree directions ('text'/'hashed'/'2dsphere') — legacy indexes can no longer crash cleanup.

_ensure_indexes() now wraps the _drop_stale_lead_indexes() call in its own try/except so backfills (create_dt/date-parts, name_lc, pipeline=false) always run even if the drop step fails. Good defence-in-depth.
Caller default index {user_id:1, create_dt:-1, id:-1} with partial active:true is fully sort-covering for the caller default list — verified empirically (desc-sorted items, sub-second response).
/api/version doc comment corrected to 16 matches actual count.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test webhook (TEST_iter82_*), 2 test leads via webhook, and 1 Ozonetel CDR lead — all deleted in cleanup fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter82 regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter82_caller_index_regression.py is self-contained and covers version marker, admin/caller leads, group_counts, same-day merge, and Ozonetel CDR. Ran 22/22 in 6.8s against preview URL. Startup index-consolidation robustness fix is production-safe: caller default index change did not regress any leads flow, and the _norm_dir tolerance means legacy non-b-tree indexes will be handled without breaking downstream backfills.
